TIR stands for Transports Internationaux Routiers, an international customs protocol enabling sealed trucks to cross multiple borders with a single customs document, simplifying procedures and avoiding taxes.

Key Details

• Purpose: Facilitates international road transport by reducing border delays and costs.
• Mechanism: Trucks are sealed and accompanied by a TIR Carnet, a customs document valid across participating countries.
• Scope: Operates in over 70 countries, simplifying cross-border logistics.
